metadata.description: Live-captured POST to the real OAuth2 client_credentials token endpoint (shape only: status code, headers, response field set/types) -- the real live call hit the cloud connect/token path, but metadata.endpoint is filed as /oauth/token to match this corpus/test-harness's established mock-matching convention for OAuth fixtures (see internal/mockserver/helpers.go NewMockClientWithOAuth2, which hardcodes /oauth/token for every mock OAuth2 client). access_token is replaced with an obvious, unambiguous placeholder string (not an anonymizer-random value) so no reader could mistake it for a real secret -- this is a disclosed, deliberate redaction, not an incidental anonymizer gap.
